purpose: Teach: 加地/今春/新選/正門/Ａ子/坂井/当地/親方

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「加地おじさんに会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting to visit Uncle Kaji.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational opener. Soft warm tone as if sharing a small detail. Even pace, natural cadence. Slight lift at the end — inviting Sho to respond.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「今春の桜祭り」に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the cherry blossom festival with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm bubbling through. Small, uncomplicated joy — no performance. Eyes light up on the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「新選組の物語を解説する」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was explaining the story of the Shinsengumi to me.
lines.style: Reflective, attentive listener. Softer pace, as if thinking back on what he said. Warm interest — you can hear she was genuinely listening. Slight breath pause before the main point.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小学校の正門で写真撮ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I took a photo by the elementary school entrance.
lines.style: Warm recollection, still energized but more grounded than before. Natural pace, matter-of-fact pride. Brief, content — like saying something obvious that makes you smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「報道のＡ子(仮名)は配慮の表記」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad explained to me how news outlets handle names with care.
lines.style: Quiet respect in the voice. Thoughtful tempo, like turning over something learned. Gentle emphasis on the consideration itself — she's noticing something good her father-figure does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと坂井おじさんの家に遊びに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I got to meet the sumo stable master.
lines.style: Pure delight, slightly awed. Slower on the main moment — the meeting itself. Eyes wide, genuine excitement without shouting. Trailing off slightly at the end, still absorbing how cool it was.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「当地の祭りに参加しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying we should join in the local festival.
lines.style: Inviting, encouraging tone. Warm and slightly conspiratorial — like she's sharing an idea he might enjoy. Steady pace, gentle forward momentum, as if planting a seed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと相撲部屋の親方に会えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I met the sumo stable master with Dad.
lines.style: Peak joy, breathless almost. Quick, bright attack on the opening. Pure unfiltered excitement — this was huge. Slight catch in the voice like he's still marveling at it.
